name: Complex-oscillator voice: bidirectional cross-FM, sync + pitch-follow slew between two VCOs, osc-modulated wavefolder into an S&H-swept self-resonant filter
goal: Patch a West-Coast complex-oscillator voice from two VCOs: hard-wire exponential FM in both directions (osc1→osc2 and osc2→osc1) and dial sweet spots with both active, use soft/hard sync on osc1, add a 'follow' (osc1 slews to track osc2's v/oct at a set follow rate) for gliding harmonies, take osc2 through a wavefolder whose shape/angle are modulated by osc1 (mod bus), then split outputs: saw → multi-filter + chorus as bass, square → arpeggio with tiny vibrato into linear FM, folded output → filter at full resonance swept by sample-and-hold, into a clocked stereo delay.

source.title: Make Noise DPO — The Ultimate Complex Oscillator?

prerequisites: Two oscillators with expo + linear FM between them, sync, a slew/'follow' path for pitch (Web Audio: two OscillatorNodes cross-feeding frequency AudioParams via GainNodes; AudioWorklet for sync, implementation note)
Resonant filter, sample-and-hold, stereo delay, sequencer

inputs.name: seq_pitch
inputs.description: Pitch sequence into osc2 (and optionally osc1)

outputs.name: complex_voice
outputs.description: Evolving FM/folded voice with bass, arp and resonant layer

constraints: Original synthesis recipe; not affiliated with any vendor named in the source. Recreate in browser/Web Audio (Polyrhythm Studio) or any hybrid synth with comparable modules; no presets, banks or samples copied.
Presenter jams by ear; no numeric settings — 'dial in the sweet spots'.
Cross-FM in both directions at once gets unstable/chaotic quickly; small amounts first.

steps.action: Exponential FM osc1→osc2: raise the amount and listen; then osc2→osc1 likewise; then use both simultaneously and find sweet spots (a little delay helps hear it).
Osc1 options: soft sync (lock) or hard sync to osc2 with a richer waveform; or switch osc1 to LFO mode as an internal modulator.

Follow: send v/oct to osc2; set osc1 to follow osc2's pitch with a follow (slew) rate so osc1 glides after it; combine sync + follow, then move osc1's pitch to find harmonies/harmonics, or disable follow so osc1 drones on one note.
steps.expect: Gliding second voice tracking the sequence

steps.action: Wavefolder output: lower the sine outputs, listen to the folder; adjust shape and angle (symmetry); bring up the mod bus so osc1 modulates the folder.
Bass: osc1 saw sequenced separately → analog filter → stereo chorus.
Arp: osc2 square plays an arpeggiated sequence with a tiny vibrato into the linear FM input.
Resonant layer: folded output → filter with resonance fully up, cutoff modulated by sample-and-hold; blend in some FM on the folder.
steps.expect: Folded tone plus singing sine from the self-resonant filter, randomly stepping

steps.action: Send everything through a clocked stereo delay; record — results are hard to recreate.

verification: Both FM directions active produces audibly different spectra from either alone.
With follow on, osc1 audibly glides after each osc2 pitch change.
Filter at full resonance with S&H shows stepped sine pitches.
